newsitem.title: USA: Labor Ready plans 100 new stores by June 30.
newsitem.headline: Labor Ready plans 100 new stores by June 30.

text.p: Labor Ready Inc, a provider of temporary workers to industrial, construction and small business markets, said it plans to open 100 new stores by June 30, adding to its current roster of 254 locations.
At the end of March one year ago, the company had opened 125 stores, or dispatch locations, it said in a statement.
Earlier, Labor Ready said its March quarter same store sales were up 40 percent from the year-ago quarter. Total sales jumped 113 percent to $23.3 million from $10.9 million in the year-ago quarter.
